header: Mario Kart 64's regular plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, 2-3 minutes with every timeout counted: the
launcher, Load ROM once the page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher and says when
it is done, and a click while it builds is lost; Firefox builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up), the
title, then A pressed through the menus to a 50cc Grand Prix's first race (Mushroom Cup, Luigi Raceway) the way a
player starts it, a need that the race is on, driven 60 s by the game's kart AI (tools/shader_survey.js's
autopilot()). The AI drives, so nothing here is timed on the game's clock. tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on
through the race's finish and results to Moo Moo Farm, for when a longer play is needed.
